
<html lang="ckb" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>کراڤا </title>
<meta name="description" content="کراڤا — ">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Vazirmatn:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
<style>
:root{
  --green-deep:#0c3d24;
  --green:#12633b;
  --green-light:#1f8a4c;
  --gold:#f5a623;
  --gold-light:#ffd873;
  --cream:#faf6ec;
  --paper:#fffdf7;
  --ink:#14180f;
  --ink-soft:#3c4736;
  --ring:rgba(245,166,35,.55);
  --shadow:0 20px 45px -18px rgba(12,61,36,.35);
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  margin:0;
  font-family:'Vazirmatn',system-ui,sans-serif;
  background:var(--cream);
  color:var(--ink);
  overflow-x:hidden;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:none;color:inherit}
h1,h2,h3,p{margin:0}
::selection{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink)}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px}

::-webkit-scrollbar{width:10px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--cream)}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--green-light);border-radius:6px}

#grain{
  position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:9998;opacity:.035;mix-blend-mode:multiply;
  background-image:radial-gradient(circle,#000 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:3px 3px;
}


#intro{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%,#153f27 0%,#0a2416 55%,#061409 100%);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:opacity .9s ease, visibility .9s ease;
}
#intro.hidden{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
#introCanvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.intro-ui{
  position:relative;z-index:2;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;
  gap:22px;text-align:center;padding:24px;
}
.intro-logo{width:min(1px,1vw);filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.45));
  animation:floaty 4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes floaty{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-10px)}}
.intro-tagline{color:var(--gold-light);font-size:clamp(.9rem,2vw,1.1rem);letter-spacing:.02em;font-weight:500}
.intro-progress{width:min(260px,60vw);height:4px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);overflow:hidden}
.intro-progress-bar{height:100%;width:0%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--gold-light));border-radius:99px;transition:width .12s linear}
.btn-enter{
  padding:14px 42px;border-radius:99px;font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),#e8901a);color:#1c1300;
  box-shadow:0 12px 28px -8px rgba(245,166,35,.55);
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px);pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .5s ease,transform .5s ease,box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.btn-enter.ready{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);pointer-events:auto}
.btn-enter:hover{box-shadow:0 16px 34px -8px rgba(245,166,35,.75)}
.intro-hint{color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);font-size:.78rem}


.eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--gold);
  font-weight:700;font-size:.82rem;letter-spacing:.03em;
}
.eyebrow::before{content:'';width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold)}
.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px}

/* ---------- NAV ---------- */
.nav{position:fixed;top:0;insetInline:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:500;transition:background .35s ease,box-shadow .35s ease,padding .35s ease}
.nav-inner{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:18px 28px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px}
.nav-logo{height:38px;width:auto;transition:height .3s ease}
.nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:30px;font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem}
.nav-links a{position:relative;padding:6px 2px;color:var(--paper)}
.nav-links a::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;right:0;width:0;height:2px;background:var(--gold);transition:width .25s ease}
.nav-links a:hover::after{width:100%}
.nav-toggle{display:none;color:var(--paper);font-size:1.4rem}
.nav.scrolled{background:rgba(12,61,36,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);box-shadow:0 8px 24px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.nav.scrolled .nav-inner{padding-block:11px}
.nav:not(.scrolled) .nav-links a{color:var(--paper)}

/* ---------- HERO ---------- */
.hero{
  position:relative;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0c3d24 0%,#123f26 55%,#faf6ec 100%);
}
#heroCanvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:1}
.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:2;text-align:center;max-width:780px;padding:150px 28px 80px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.hero-content h1{
  color:var(--paper);font-size:clamp(2.3rem,6vw,4rem);line-height:1.18;font-weight:800;
}
.hero-content h1 .accent{color:var(--gold)}
.hero-content h1 .accent-2{color:var(--gold-light)}
.hero-content p{color:rgba(255,253,247,.82);font-size:clamp(1rem,2vw,1.15rem);max-width:560px;line-height:1.9}
.hero-cta{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin-top:6px}
.btn{padding:14px 30px;border-radius:99px;font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;transition:transform .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease}
.btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),#e8901a);color:#1c1300;box-shadow:0 14px 30px -10px rgba(245,166,35,.6)}
.btn-outline{border:2px solid rgba(255,253,247,.6);color:var(--paper)}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold-light)}
.scroll-cue{position:absolute;bottom:30px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:2;color:rgba(255,253,247,.65);font-size:.78rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.scroll-cue span{width:1px;height:34px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold),transparent);animation:scrolldown 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes scrolldown{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-6px)}50%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}}

/* ---------- SHOWCASE ---------- */
.showcase{background:var(--paper);padding:110px 0;position:relative}
.showcase-inner{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:60px;align-items:center}
.showcase-text h2{font-size:clamp(1.7rem,3.4vw,2.5rem);font-weight:800;margin:14px 0 16px;line-height:1.3}
.showcase-text p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:1.02rem;line-height:1.85;max-width:460px}
.mode-toggle{display:flex;gap:10px;margin:26px 0 20px;background:var(--cream);padding:6px;border-radius:99px;width:fit-content}
.mode-btn{padding:10px 22px;border-radius:99px;font-weight:700;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--ink-soft);transition:all .3s ease}
.mode-btn.active{background:var(--green-deep);color:var(--paper);box-shadow:0 8px 18px -8px rgba(12,61,36,.5)}
.swatches{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:center;min-height:80px}
.swatch{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid transparent;box-shadow:0 4px 10px -3px rgba(0,0,0,.35);transition:transform .2s ease,border-color .2s ease}
.swatch:hover{transform:scale(1.12)}
.swatch.active{border-color:var(--ink)}
.swatch-label{width:100%;font-size:.92rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--green-deep);margin-top:2px}
.showcase-stage{
  position:relative;aspect-ratio:1/1;border-radius:28px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%,#eaf3e5 0%,#dcecd4 45%,#cfe4c6 100%);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(12,61,36,.08),var(--shadow);
  overflow:hidden;
}
#showcaseCanvas{width:100%;height:100%;cursor:grab;touch-action:none}
#showcaseCanvas:active{cursor:grabbing}
.drag-hint{
  position:absolute;bottom:16px;insetInline:0;text-align:center;font-size:.82rem;
  color:var(--green-deep);opacity:.65;pointer-events:none;font-weight:600;
}

/* ---------- MENU SECTIONS ---------- */
.menu-section{position:relative}
.menu-banner{position:relative;height:52vh;min-height:340px;background-size:cover;background-position:center;display:flex;align-items:flex-end}
.banner-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(6,20,12,.35) 0%,rgba(6,20,12,.55) 55%,var(--cream) 100%)}
.banner-content{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px 46px;width:100%}
.banner-content h2{color:var(--paper);font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.7rem);font-weight:800;margin:10px 0 10px}
.banner-content .eyebrow{color:var(--gold-light)}
.banner-content .eyebrow::before{background:var(--gold-light)}
.section-sub{color:rgba(255,253,247,.85);font-size:1rem;max-width:560px;line-height:1.8}
.menu-body{background:var(--cream);padding:60px 0 100px}
.card-grid{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:22px}

.menu-card{
  perspective:900px;
}
.menu-card-inner{
  background:var(--paper);border-radius:20px;padding:26px 20px 22px;
  box-shadow:0 12px 30px -16px rgba(12,61,36,.3);
  transform:rotateX(var(--rx,0deg)) rotateY(var(--ry,0deg)) translateZ(0);
  transition:transform .12s ease-out,box-shadow .3s ease;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:10px;
  height:100%;border:1px solid rgba(12,61,36,.06);
}
.menu-card:hover .menu-card-inner{box-shadow:0 22px 42px -16px rgba(12,61,36,.45)}
.card-icon-stage{width:74px;height:74px;perspective:520px;animation:cardBob 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:var(--dl,0s)}
.card-icon{width:100%;height:100%;transform-style:preserve-3d;animation:cardSpin var(--sd,6s) linear infinite;animation-delay:var(--dl,0s)}
@keyframes cardSpin{from{transform:rotateY(0deg) rotateX(8deg)}to{transform:rotateY(360deg) rotateX(8deg)}}
@keyframes cardBob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-7px)}}
.menu-card:hover .card-icon,.menu-card:focus-within .card-icon{animation-play-state:paused}
.card-name{font-weight:800;font-size:1.02rem;line-height:1.4}
.card-sub{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.76rem;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.6}
.card-price{
  margin-top:6px;padding:5px 16px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--cream);
  font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--green-deep);border:1px solid rgba(12,61,36,.12);
}

/* ---------- FOOTER ---------- */
.footer{background:var(--green-deep);color:var(--paper);padding:70px 0 30px;position:relative}
.footer-inner{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:18px}
.footer-logo{height:52px;filter:brightness(1.15)}
.footer-tag{color:var(--gold-light);font-weight:600}
.footer-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:40px;margin:14px 0;font-size:.92rem}
.footer-meta div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.footer-meta strong{color:var(--gold)}
.footer-meta span{color:rgba(255,253,247,.75)}
.footer-note{color:rgba(255,253,247,.5);font-size:.8rem;max-width:520px;line-height:1.7}
.copyright{color:rgba(255,253,247,.4);font-size:.78rem;margin-top:10px}
.footer-divider{width:60px;height:2px;background:var(--gold);border-radius:2px;opacity:.6}

@media (max-width:860px){
  .showcase-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .showcase-stage{max-width:420px;margin:0 auto;width:100%}
  .nav-links{position:fixed;top:0;insetInline:0;right:0;left:0;background:var(--green-deep);flex-direction:column;
    padding:100px 30px 40px;height:100vh;transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .4s ease;gap:26px;font-size:1.15rem}
  html[dir="rtl"] .nav-links{transform:translateX(100%)}
  .nav-links.open{transform:translateX(0)}
  .nav-toggle{display:block;z-index:600}
}
@media (max-width:520px){
  .hero-content{padding-top:130px}
  .footer-meta{gap:24px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  .intro-logo{animation:none}
  .scroll-cue span{animation:none}
  .menu-card-inner{transition:none}
  .card-icon-stage,.card-icon{animation:none}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="grain"></div>

<div id="intro">
  <canvas id="introCanvas"></canvas>
  <div class="intro-ui">
    <img class="intro-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="کراڤا">
    <p class="intro-tagline">تامی ڕەسەن، هەستێکی نوێ</p>
    <div class="intro-progress"><div class="intro-progress-bar" id="introBar"></div></div>
    <button id="enterBtn" class="btn-enter">بچۆرە ژوورەوە</button>
    <p class="intro-hint">یان کلیک لەسەر شاشەکە بکە</p>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="site">
  <header class="nav" id="siteNav">
    <div class="nav-inner">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," class="nav-logo" alt="کراڤا">
      <nav class="nav-links" id="navLinks">
        <a href="#hero">سەرەکی</a>
        <a href="#showcase">نمایشی زیندوو</a>
        <a href="#juice">شەربەت</a>
        <a href="#fries">پەتاتە</a>
        <a href="#footer">پەیوەندی</a>
      </nav>
      <button class="nav-toggle" id="navToggle" aria-label="کردنەوەی لیستە">☰</button>
    </div>
  </header>

  <section id="hero" class="hero">
    <canvas id="heroCanvas"></canvas>
    <div class="hero-content">
      <span class="eyebrow"> بەخێر بێن بۆ کڕاڤا </span>
      <h1>تامی <span class="accent">تازە</span>، هەستی <span class="accent-2">ڕاستەقینە</span></h1>
      <p>شەربەتی میوەی سروشتی و پەتاتەی گەرمی تازە —  .</p>
      <div class="hero-cta">
        <a href="#juice" class="btn btn-primary">بینینی شەربەتەکان</a>
        <a href="#fries" class="btn btn-outline">بینینی پەتاتەکان</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="scroll-cue"><span></span> بۆ خوارەوە بڕۆ</div>
  </section>

  <section id="showcase" class="showcase">
    <div class="showcase-inner">
      <div class="showcase-text">
        <span class="eyebrow">نمایشی زیندووی ٣D</span>
        <h2>دەستکاری بکە، بیسوڕێنە، هەستی پێبکە</h2>
        <p>بە ماوس یان پەنجەت  ڕابکێشە بۆ سوڕاندنەوە، پاشان جۆر و تامەکە هەڵبژێرە.</p>
        <div class="mode-toggle">
          <button data-mode="cup" class="mode-btn active"> شەربەت</button>
          <button data-mode="cone" class="mode-btn"> پەتاتە</button>
        </div>
        <div class="swatches" id="swatches"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="showcase-stage">
        <canvas id="showcaseCanvas"></canvas>
        <p class="drag-hint">🖐 ڕایبکێشە بۆ سوڕاندنەوە</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="juice" class="menu-section">
    <div class="menu-banner" style="background-image:url(data:image/jpeg;base64,)">
      <div class="banner-overlay"></div>
      <div class="banner-content">
        <span class="eyebrow">١٥ تامی جیاواز</span>
        <h2>شەربەتی میوەی تازە</h2>
        <p class="section-sub">هەموو ڕۆژێک لە میوەی تازە دروستدەکرێت، بێ هیچ زیادکراوی دەستکرد.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="menu-body">
      <div class="card-grid" id="juiceGrid"></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="fries" class="menu-section">
    <div class="menu-banner" style="background-image:url(data:image/jpeg;base64,)">
      <div class="banner-overlay"></div>
      <div class="banner-content">
        <span class="eyebrow">٥ جۆری ترسکە</span>
        <h2>پەتاتەی  گەرم</h2>
        <p class="section-sub">پەتاتەی تازە بە شێوەیەکی ترسکە سووراوکراوە، لەگەڵ سۆسی تایبەتی کراڤا.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="menu-body">
      <div class="card-grid" id="friesGrid"></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <footer id="footer" class="footer">
    <div class="footer-inner">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," class="footer-logo" alt="کراڤا">
      <div class="footer-divider"></div>
      <p class="footer-tag">تامی تازە، هەموو ڕۆژێک</p>
      <div class="footer-meta">
        <div><strong>کاتژمێرەکان</strong><span>ڕۆژانە5:00 – 12:00</span></div>
        <div><strong>شوێن</strong><span>، سۆران - حریق</span></div>
        <div><strong>پەیوەندی</strong><span>instagram.com/crava.cafe</span></div>
      </div>
      <p class="footer-note">تێبینی: ئەم پەڕەیە تەنها بۆ نیشاندانی مینیوەیە — داواکاری ئۆنلاین لێرە بەردەست نییە.</p>
      <p class="copyright">© ٢٠٢٦ کراڤا. هەموو مافەکان پارێزراون.</p>
    </div>
  </footer>
</div>

<script>
"use strict";
const LOGO_URI = "data:image/png;base64,";
const REDUCE_MOTION = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

/* ===================== DATA ===================== */
const juiceItems = [
  {name:'پرتەقاڵ', sub:'Orange', color:'#f5a623', price:'١٥٠٠'},
  {name:'سێو', sub:'Apple', color:'#8bc34a', price:'١٥٠٠'},
  {name:'مۆز', sub:'Banana', color:'#fde05a', price:'١٥٠٠'},
  {name:'توتی فەرەنگی', sub:'Strawberry', color:'#e1443b', price:'١٧٥٠'},
  {name:'هەنار', sub:'Pomegranate', color:'#9c1f3c', price:'٢٠٠٠'},
  {name:'کیوی', sub:'Kiwi', color:'#8baa3c', price:'١٧٥٠'},
  {name:'مانگۆ', sub:'Mango', color:'#ffb13c', price:'١٧٥٠'},
  {name:'ئەناناس', sub:'Pineapple', color:'#f4d93e', price:'١٧٥٠'},
  {name:'شەفتاڵوو', sub:'Peach', color:'#ffae7a', price:'١٧٥٠'},
  {name:'بەتیخ', sub:'Watermelon', color:'#ef5b63', price:'١٥٠٠'},
  {name:'لیمۆ', sub:'Lemon', color:'#e7e24b', price:'١٥٠٠'},
  {name:'خەرمانی', sub:'Cantaloupe', color:'#f2c24e', price:'١٧٥٠'},
  {name:'تووت', sub:'Mulberry', color:'#5a2a52', price:'٢٠٠٠'},
  {name:'تێکەڵی گرمۆزایی', sub:'Tropical Mix', color:'#f5871f', price:'٢٢٥٠'},
  {name:'تێکەڵی وەرزی', sub:'Seasonal Mix', color:'#7cb342', price:'٢٢٥٠'},
];
const friesItems = [
  {name:'پەتاتەی سادە', sub:'Classic Fries', color:'#f3c969', price:'٢٠٠٠'},
  {name:'پەتاتەی پەنیر', sub:'Cheese Fries', color:'#f7d24c', price:'٢٥٠٠'},
  {name:'پەتاتەی بەیکن و پەنیر', sub:'Bacon & Cheese', color:'#e08a3e', price:'٣٥٠٠'},
  {name:'پەتاتەی سپایسی', sub:'Spicy Fries', color:'#d9482f', price:'٢٥٠٠'},
  {name:'پەتاتەی تایبەتی کراڤا', sub:'CRAVA Special', color:'#0f4d2e', price:'٤٠٠٠'},
];

/* ===================== SVG ICON BUILDERS ===================== */
function svgCup(color){
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" class="card-icon"><defs>
    <linearGradient id="g${color.slice(1)}" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${color}" stop-opacity=".95"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${color}" stop-opacity=".55"/>
    </linearGradient></defs>
    <path d="M28 30 H72 L66 82 Q66 88 60 88 H40 Q34 88 34 82 Z" fill="#fffdf7" stroke="#0c3d24" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M31 40 H69 L64 80 Q64 84 60 84 H40 Q36 84 36 80 Z" fill="url(#g${color.slice(1)})"/>
    <rect x="24" y="22" width="52" height="10" rx="4" fill="#0c3d24"/>
    <rect x="24" y="30" width="52" height="4" fill="#f5a623"/>
  </svg>`;
}
function svgCone(color){
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" class="card-icon"><defs>
    <linearGradient id="c${color.slice(1)}" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${color}"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0c3d24"/>
    </linearGradient></defs>
    <polygon points="50,90 14,18 86,18" fill="url(#c${color.slice(1)})" stroke="#0c3d24" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="50,68 33,38 67,38" fill="#fffdf7" opacity=".9"/>
    <rect x="20" y="12" width="60" height="9" rx="3" fill="#f5a623"/>
    <line x1="38" y1="18" x2="35" y2="4" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="50" y1="14" x2="50" y2="2" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="62" y1="18" x2="65" y2="4" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </svg>`;
}

/* ===================== RENDER MENU CARDS ===================== */
function buildGrid(container, items, iconFn){
  container.innerHTML = items.map((it,i) => {
    const dur = (5.5 + (i%5)*.6 + Math.random()*1.4).toFixed(2);
    const delay = (-(Math.random()*dur)).toFixed(2);
    return `
    <div class="menu-card" tabindex="0">
      <div class="menu-card-inner">
        <div class="card-icon-stage" style="--sd:${dur}s;--dl:${delay}s">${iconFn(it.color)}</div>
        <div class="card-name">${it.name}</div>
        <div class="card-sub">${it.sub}</div>
        <div class="card-price">${it.price} د.ع</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}
buildGrid(document.getElementById('juiceGrid'), juiceItems, svgCup);
buildGrid(document.getElementById('friesGrid'), friesItems, svgCone);

/* tilt effect */
function attachTilt(root){
  root.querySelectorAll('.menu-card').forEach(card=>{
    const inner = card.querySelector('.menu-card-inner');
    card.addEventListener('mousemove', e=>{
      if(REDUCE_MOTION) return;
      const r = card.getBoundingClientRect();
      const px = (e.clientX - r.left)/r.width - .5;
      const py = (e.clientY - r.top)/r.height - .5;
      inner.style.setProperty('--rx', (-py*10).toFixed(2)+'deg');
      inner.style.setProperty('--ry', (px*10).toFixed(2)+'deg');
    });
    card.addEventListener('mouseleave', ()=>{
      inner.style.setProperty('--rx','0deg');
      inner.style.setProperty('--ry','0deg');
    });
  });
}
attachTilt(document.getElementById('juiceGrid'));
attachTilt(document.getElementById('friesGrid'));

/* ===================== NAV ===================== */
const nav = document.getElementById('siteNav');
window.addEventListener('scroll', ()=>{
  nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 40);
});
const navToggle = document.getElementById('navToggle');
const navLinks = document.getElementById('navLinks');
navToggle.addEventListener('click', ()=> navLinks.classList.toggle('open'));
navLinks.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a=> a.addEventListener('click', ()=> navLinks.classList.remove('open')));

/* ===================== THREE.JS HELPERS ===================== */
let logoImage = new Image();
let logoImageReady = false;
logoImage.onload = ()=>{ logoImageReady = true; };
logoImage.src = LOGO_URI;

function makeLabelTexture(){
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = 1024; canvas.height = 512;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.fillStyle = '#faf6ec'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,1024,512);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0c3d24'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,1024,26); ctx.fillRect(0,486,1024,26);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f5a623'; ctx.fillRect(0,26,1024,9); ctx.fillRect(0,477,1024,9);
  if(logoImageReady){
    const iw = 480, ih = iw*logoImage.height/logoImage.width;
    ctx.drawImage(logoImage,(1024-iw)/2,(512-ih)/2,iw,ih);
  }
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
  tex.needsUpdate = true;
  tex.anisotropy = 4;
  return tex;
}

function buildCupGroup(liquidColor){
  const group = new THREE.Group();
  const label = makeLabelTexture();
  const cupMat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({map:label, transparent:true, opacity:.92, roughness:.25, metalness:0, clearcoat:.4});
  const cupGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.15,.95,2.3,48,1,true);
  const cup = new THREE.Mesh(cupGeo, cupMat);
  group.add(cup);

  const liquidGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.0,.85,1.7,48);
  const liquidMat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({color:liquidColor, roughness:.15, metalness:.05, transparent:true, opacity:.92});
  const liquid = new THREE.Mesh(liquidGeo, liquidMat);
  liquid.position.y = -0.35;
  liquid.name = 'liquid';
  group.add(liquid);

  const rimGeo = new THREE.TorusGeometry(1.16,.05,16,48);
  const rimMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x0c3d24, roughness:.4});
  const rim = new THREE.Mesh(rimGeo, rimMat);
  rim.rotation.x = Math.PI/2;
  rim.position.y = 1.15;
  group.add(rim);

  const strawGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.055,.055,2.6,12);
  const strawMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x141414, roughness:.3});
  const straw = new THREE.Mesh(strawGeo, strawMat);
  straw.position.set(.35,1.35,0);
  straw.rotation.z = .22;
  group.add(straw);

  return group;
}

function buildConeGroup(accentColor){
  const group = new THREE.Group();
  const label = makeLabelTexture();
  const coneMat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({map:label, roughness:.55, metalness:0});
  const coneGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.35,0,2.7,3,1,false);
  const cone = new THREE.Mesh(coneGeo, coneMat);
  cone.rotation.y = Math.PI/6;
  group.add(cone);

  const friesMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xf5cf6b, roughness:.5});
  const accentMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:accentColor, roughness:.45});
  for(let i=0;i<9;i++){
    const useAccent = i % 4 === 0;
    const stick = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.14,1.1,.14), useAccent?accentMat:friesMat);
    const angle = (i/9)*Math.PI*2;
    stick.position.set(Math.cos(angle)*.5, 1.25+Math.random()*.25, Math.sin(angle)*.5);
    stick.rotation.set((Math.random()-.5)*.6,(Math.random()-.5)*.6,(Math.random()-.5)*.6);
    group.add(stick);
  }

  const forkMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x1a1a1a, roughness:.3});
  const fork = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.05,.05,2.2,10), forkMat);
  fork.position.set(.55,1.5,-.2);
  fork.rotation.z = .5;
  fork.rotation.x = .15;
  group.add(fork);

  return group;
}

/* ===================== INTRO SCENE ===================== */
const introCanvas = document.getElementById('introCanvas');
const introRenderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas:introCanvas, antialias:true, alpha:true});
introRenderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio,2));
const introScene = new THREE.Scene();
const introCamera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, .1, 100);
introCamera.position.set(0,1,9);

introScene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff,.55));
const introKey = new THREE.PointLight(0xf5a623, 1.4, 30); introKey.position.set(5,6,5); introScene.add(introKey);
const introRim = new THREE.PointLight(0x1f8a4c, 1.1, 30); introRim.position.set(-6,-2,-4); introScene.add(introRim);

const introCup = buildCupGroup(0xf5a623);
introCup.position.set(-2.1,0,0);
introCup.scale.setScalar(1.1);
introScene.add(introCup);

const introCone = buildConeGroup(0xd9482f);
introCone.position.set(2.1,-.3,0);
introCone.scale.setScalar(1.05);
introScene.add(introCone);

const introLogoGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(3.4,1.9);
const introLogoMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:new THREE.TextureLoader().load(LOGO_URI), transparent:true, depthWrite:false});
const introLogoPlane = new THREE.Mesh(introLogoGeo, introLogoMat);
introLogoPlane.position.set(0,2.6,0);
introScene.add(introLogoPlane);

const sparkGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
const sparkCount = 140;
const sparkPos = new Float32Array(sparkCount*3);
for(let i=0;i<sparkCount;i++){
  sparkPos[i*3] = (Math.random()-.5)*16;
  sparkPos[i*3+1] = (Math.random()-.5)*10;
  sparkPos[i*3+2] = (Math.random()-.5)*10;
}
sparkGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(sparkPos,3));
const sparkMat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({color:0xf5d99a, size:.045, transparent:true, opacity:.7});
const sparks = new THREE.Points(sparkGeo, sparkMat);
introScene.add(sparks);

function resizeIntro(){
  introCamera.aspect = window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight;
  introCamera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  introRenderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
}
resizeIntro();
window.addEventListener('resize', resizeIntro);

let introActive = true;
let introClock = 0;
function animateIntro(){
  if(!introActive) return;
  requestAnimationFrame(animateIntro);
  introClock += REDUCE_MOTION? 0 : 0.012;
  introCup.rotation.y += REDUCE_MOTION? 0 : .012;
  introCone.rotation.y -= REDUCE_MOTION? 0 : .009;
  introLogoPlane.rotation.y = Math.sin(introClock*.6)*.35;
  introCamera.position.x = Math.sin(introClock*.4)*3.2;
  introCamera.position.z = 15+ Math.cos(introClock*.4)*1.2;
  introCamera.lookAt(0,0.4,0);
  sparks.rotation.y += .0007;
  introRenderer.render(introScene, introCamera);
}
animateIntro();

/* progress + enter */
const introBar = document.getElementById('introBar');
const enterBtn = document.getElementById('enterBtn');
let progress = 0;
const progressTimer = setInterval(()=>{
  progress += Math.random()*9+4;
  if(progress >= 100){
    progress = 100;
    clearInterval(progressTimer);
    enterBtn.classList.add('ready');
  }
  introBar.style.width = progress+'%';
}, 130);

function enterSite(){
  if(!enterBtn.classList.contains('ready')) return;
  document.getElementById('intro').classList.add('hidden');
  introActive = false;
  
  /* ئەم دێڕە بە سەلامەتی پەیجەکە دەباتەوە سەرەوە بۆ بەشی هێرۆ */
  document.getElementById('hero').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  
  setTimeout(()=>{
    introRenderer.dispose();
    initHero();
    initShowcase();
  }, 500);
}

}
enterBtn.addEventListener('click', enterSite);
document.getElementById('intro').addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
  if(e.target === document.getElementById('intro') || e.target === introCanvas) enterSite();
});
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
  if((e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') && !document.getElementById('intro').classList.contains('hidden')) enterSite();
});

/* ===================== HERO AMBIENT SCENE ===================== */
let heroInited = false;
function initHero(){
  if(heroInited) return;
  heroInited = true;
  const canvas = document.getElementById('heroCanvas');
  const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas, antialias:true, alpha:true});
  renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio,2));
  const scene = new THREE.Scene();
  const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(50, canvas.clientWidth/canvas.clientHeight, .1, 100);
  camera.position.set(0,0,10);

  scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff,.6));
  const key = new THREE.PointLight(0xf5a623,1.2,30); key.position.set(4,4,6); scene.add(key);
  const rim = new THREE.PointLight(0x1f8a4c,1,30); rim.position.set(-5,-3,-2); scene.add(rim);

  const items = [];
  const configs = [
    {type:'cup', color:0xe1443b, pos:[-4.2,1.2,-1]},
    {type:'cone', color:0xf3c969, pos:[4,-1.4,-2]},
    {type:'cup', color:0x8bc34a, pos:[3.6,2,-3]},
    {type:'cone', color:0xd9482f, pos:[-3.4,-2,-2.5]},
  ];
  configs.forEach(cfg=>{
    const g = cfg.type==='cup' ? buildCupGroup(cfg.color) : buildConeGroup(cfg.color);
    g.scale.setScalar(.62);
    g.position.set(...cfg.pos);
    g.userData.baseY = cfg.pos[1];
    g.userData.speed = .5 + Math.random()*.4;
    g.userData.offset = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    scene.add(g);
    items.push(g);
  });

  function resize(){
    const w = canvas.clientWidth, h = canvas.clientHeight;
    camera.aspect = w/h; camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(w,h,false);
  }
  resize();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

  let mouseX=0, mouseY=0;
  window.addEventListener('mousemove', e=>{
    mouseX = (e.clientX/window.innerWidth - .5);
    mouseY = (e.clientY/window.innerHeight - .5);
  });

  let t=0;
  function loop(){
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    if(document.hidden) return;
    t += REDUCE_MOTION? 0 : .016;
    items.forEach(g=>{
      g.position.y = g.userData.baseY + Math.sin(t*g.userData.speed + g.userData.offset)*.35;
      g.rotation.y += REDUCE_MOTION? 0 : .006;
    });
    camera.position.x += (mouseX*1.4 - camera.position.x)*.03;
    camera.position.y += (-mouseY*1.0 - camera.position.y)*.03;
    camera.lookAt(0,0,0);
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
  }
  loop();
}

/* ===================== SHOWCASE INTERACTIVE SCENE ===================== */
let showcaseInited = false;
function initShowcase(){
  if(showcaseInited) return;
  showcaseInited = true;
  const canvas = document.getElementById('showcaseCanvas');
  const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas, antialias:true, alpha:true});
  renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio,2));
  const scene = new THREE.Scene();
  const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(42, 1, .1, 100);
  camera.position.set(0,.2,6.5);

  scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff,.7));
  const key = new THREE.PointLight(0xf5a623,1.3,30); key.position.set(4,5,5); scene.add(key);
  const rim = new THREE.PointLight(0x1f8a4c,1,30); rim.position.set(-4,-3,-3); scene.add(rim);
  const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,.4); fill.position.set(0,3,4); scene.add(fill);

  let mode = 'cup';
  let current = buildCupGroup(0xf5a623);
  scene.add(current);

  const cupSwatches = [
    {label:'پرتەقاڵ', color:0xf5a623},
    {label:'توتی فەرەنگی', color:0xe1443b},
    {label:'کیوی', color:0x8baa3c},
    {label:'هەنار', color:0x9c1f3c},
    {label:'مانگۆ', color:0xffb13c},
    {label:'لیمۆ', color:0xe7e24b},
  ];
  const coneSwatches = [
    {label:'سادە', color:0xf3c969},
    {label:'پەنیر', color:0xf7d24c},
    {label:'بەیکن و پەنیر', color:0xe08a3e},
    {label:'سپایسی', color:0xd9482f},
    {label:'تایبەتی کراڤا', color:0x0f4d2e},
  ];

  const swatchWrap = document.getElementById('swatches');
  function renderSwatches(){
    const list = mode==='cup' ? cupSwatches : coneSwatches;
    swatchWrap.innerHTML = '<div class="swatch-label" id="swatchLabel">'+list[0].label+'</div>' +
      list.map((s,i)=>`<button class="swatch ${i===0?'active':''}" style="background:#${s.color.toString(16).padStart(6,'0')}" data-color="${s.color}" data-label="${s.label}" aria-label="${s.label}"></button>`).join('');
    swatchWrap.querySelectorAll('.swatch').forEach(btn=>{
      btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
        swatchWrap.querySelectorAll('.swatch').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        document.getElementById('swatchLabel').textContent = btn.dataset.label;
        applyColor(parseInt(btn.dataset.color));
      });
    });
  }
  function applyColor(color){
    if(mode==='cup'){
      const liquid = current.getObjectByName('liquid');
      if(liquid) liquid.material.color.setHex(color);
    } else {
      scene.remove(current);
      current = buildConeGroup(color);
      scene.add(current);
    }
  }
  renderSwatches();

  document.querySelectorAll('.mode-btn').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      document.querySelectorAll('.mode-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
      btn.classList.add('active');
      mode = btn.dataset.mode;
      scene.remove(current);
      current = mode==='cup' ? buildCupGroup(0xf5a623) : buildConeGroup(0xf3c969);
      scene.add(current);
      renderSwatches();
    });
  });

  function resize(){
    const w = canvas.clientWidth, h = canvas.clientHeight;
    camera.aspect = w/h; camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(w,h,false);
  }
  resize();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

  let dragging=false, lastX=0, lastY=0;
  let rotY=0, rotX=0, velY=0;
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', e=>{
    dragging=true; lastX=e.clientX; lastY=e.clientY; canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });
  window.addEventListener('pointermove', e=>{
    if(!dragging) return;
    const dx = e.clientX-lastX, dy = e.clientY-lastY;
    lastX=e.clientX; lastY=e.clientY;
    rotY += dx*.008; rotX += dy*.008;
    rotX = Math.max(-.6,Math.min(.6,rotX));
    velY = dx*.008;
  });
  window.addEventListener('pointerup', ()=> dragging=false);

  let t=0;
  function loop(){
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    if(document.hidden) return;
    t += .016;
    if(!dragging && !REDUCE_MOTION){
      rotY += .004 + velY*0;
      velY *= .95;
    }
    current.rotation.y = rotY;
    current.rotation.x = rotX;
    current.position.y = Math.sin(t*.8)*.08;
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
  }
  loop();
}

document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', ()=>{});
</script>
</body>
</html>
